SIEM correlation identified 23 successful logons from suspicious source IP to admin-like accounts in Finance OU. Incident triggered.
EDR/NDR confirms no malicious payloads on endpoint; UBA flags anomalous access patterns (redacted for sensitivity).
Admin response initiated: attempted bulk revocation of 23 Finance accounts. Partial success — only individual revocations processed due to system constraints.
Incident escalated to SOC Lead for procedural review and detection enhancement planning.

Full EPP scan completed on initial compromised host 10.0.2.15; no threats detected.

All 50 Finance department user accounts revoked due to suspected credential harvesting.
